scope: Independent read-only review of ten batch10 offset-1 decisions, including broad falsification review of 滿面慚惶.

rows.reason: The legal surrender/self-incrimination image repeatedly appraises a participant as voluntarily submitting to the ancestral case and its judgment.
The normalized 解脫深坑 is a recurrent warning that attachment to liberation itself becomes confinement; printed graph resolution is exact.
The old/not-old pairing repeatedly forms one answer and verse formula contrasting conditioned age with the ageless matter.

The rejection underreads the full cases. Across independent works the phrase repeatedly serves as a stock Chan verdict: an inadequate responder, teacher, or inherited position is exposed, defeated, left without a place to stand, or unable to answer back. It caps critiques of the Buddha's awakening, Mazu's illness case, Linji's encounter, the shopkeeper/jewel case, and direct interview answers such as 滿面慚惶不識羞. This recurrence is an observable encounter and case-critical deployment, not merely incidental facial narration. Revise REJECT to KEEP (component).
Independent Linji-style addresses explicitly name host/guest exchange as responsive role reversal, paired with whole-body taking and giving.
The exact dismissal is fixed in the Dayu-Linji case and also used in independent interview teaching, supporting a stable encounter line.
Both textual-corruption clauses form one proverb repeatedly applied to distortion of ancestral words and transmission records.
Masters repeatedly turn 'not even one thing' into a direct doctrinal answer and an immediately tested claim of residue-free emptiness.
The sea-spirit pearl verdict repeatedly distinguishes recognizing preciousness from being able to assess or use what is recognized.
The thread-and-line image repeatedly appraises tightly reciprocal, continuous encounter exchange, sometimes critically as verbal ingenuity.
